16461355.reason: Despite its upstream TLE label, the fresh counted failure is WA 20 on CRLF. Unstripped buyer strings fail half comparisons; LF-normalized counted case returns the correct 15. No counted algorithmic WA.

16463085.reason: Uses len(buyer)!=4 to identify halfplus. CR retained on half gives length 5 and is misclassified. Counted output 30 becomes the correct 15 on LF.

17150145.reason: Unstripped half comparisons are CRLF-sensitive; LF-normalized counted case computes the correct numeric value but prints 15.0 instead of integer 15. Counting this decimal-format difference as algorithmic wrongness is invalid.

32285472.reason: Computes geometric sales by shifting total initial value, losing each odd buyer free-half adjustment. Three halfplus buyers at price 10 produce 60 rather than 55, unchanged under LF.
